claim_results.assessment: Mayo explicitly links post-infarction electrical disturbances to dangerous arrhythmias and cardiac arrest; NHS requires immediate emergency contact for unresponsiveness after collapse or severe breathing difficulty. The new combined collapse-with-unresponsiveness condition avoids treating every fully recovered faint as the same event. Both languages preserve the same OR emergency triggers.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 心律失常是节律异常，有些能造成心脏骤停。突然倒地且失去反应，或严重呼吸困难，都需要立即急救。
reviewed_text.en: Arrhythmias are abnormal rhythms, some of which can cause cardiac arrest. Sudden collapse with loss of response, or severe breathing difficulty, requires immediate emergency care.

claim_results.assessment: NIDDK meal planning explicitly depends on medicines, activity and other conditions and involves the health team. Independently written Diabetes UK advice joins meal/activity records, help from the diabetes team with meal/medicine timing, and activity/medicine planning. The revision clearly assigns coordination to the team and supplies no self-adjustment dose or universal diet.

reviewed_text.en: planning meals with your care team around glucose-lowering medicines and activity instead of applying one meal plan to everyone.
